**The Role

**You will own and lead global communication strategy for our Urology business area, playing a central role in Ambu’s transformation toward more insight-driven, digitally fluent, and customer-centric marketing. Based at our headquarters in Ballerup, Denmark, you will work closely with other Global MarCom Managers, our Brand & Creation team, Digital Marketing Specialists, Global Product Managers, Medical Affairs, and local sales companies to develop customer-centric, insight-driven, and commercially impactful communication. Your primary team consists of downstream product managers and you will work together on the daily to drive the Urology business forward.

Drive commercial marketing and business impact You will develop and optimize communication throughout the customer journey and your ability to seek out insights, interpret limited data, and translate findings into impactful communication will be essential to our success. From ideation to execution, you’ll ensure alignment, consistency, and commercial impact throughout the customer journey.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Own and lead the development and execution of global communication strategy for Urology, with a strong drive to build data-based customer communication.

• Developing sales enablement materials and content that empower commercial teams and drive engagement with healthcare professionals.

• Collaborating closely with the Digital Marketing team to identify performance and adapt communications accordingly.

• Collaborate with the Brand and Creative team to deliver sales & marketing materials that are both on-brand and commercially effective.

**Commercial mindset, proactive and collaborative

**You are a data-driven, commercially minded marketer, motivated by the challenge of building this capability in a less mature environment. You understand customer journeys and develop communication strategies that optimize business impact, even when insights are limited. You are resourceful, curious, and proactive in seeking out insights, and you can turn even small data points into meaningful communication. You enjoy collaborating with others and are eager to help shape our data-driven future. You’re skilled at managing stakeholders and building alignment across global teams.

To succeed, you’ll need: **Skills

**_Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you have:

_

• A Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field

• 10+ years of experience in commercial marketing, acquired in corporate roles, agencies, or both.

• Proven commercial experience within MedTech or Pharma.

• A proven ability to connect marketing to business results through communication & channel strategy, and sales enablement.

• Driven, hands-on, and strong sense of ownership.

• Strong project leadership skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across time zones and functions.

• A proactive mindset with the ability to drive transformation in how we engage HCPs and stakeholders

• Excellent communication skills in English (verbal and written)

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is on an ambitious growth journey, expanding globally and pushing the boundaries of innovation in healthcare. Here, your contributions will directly shape our success. You’ll work in an international head office with a collaborative, open culture—where ideas matter, and impact is visible. We offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits along with exciting job challenges and career opportunities contributing to your job satisfaction.

**When to apply

**If you are ready to apply for the position, please apply. Your application will be treated confidentially.

Sparrow Quantum is seeking a talent acquisition and HR partner to lead recruitment and grow into a broader HR role

• Type: Permanent, full-time position

• Compensation: According to qualifications

• Location: Copenhagen

• Start date: February 1, 2027 (flexible)

• Reports to: VP of Finance

About the role

Sparrow Quantum is growing fast, and the people we hire in the coming years will shape what the company becomes. We are looking for a talent acquisition and HR partner who can lead our recruiting efforts and grow with our HR function.

Recruitment is the core of the role. You will own hiring from the first conversation with a hiring manager to the signed contract, across scientific, engineering, and commercial roles, in Denmark and internationally. Some travel might be expected.

Initially, your focus will be on talent acquisition. Once core hiring is under way, you will gradually take on more of the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding, with support from external HR partners. HR at Sparrow Quantum is a function under development, and the role will grow with it, with a path towards Head of HR.

Responsibilities

Core responsibilities - leading talent acquisition

• Own the full recruitment process, from role definition with hiring managers to offer and contract-signing

• Source and attract candidates for specialist roles in quantum photonics, engineering, and production, as well as business functions

• Work with our Communications & Marketing Manager on building our employer brand and a talent pipeline, including attending job fairs at local and international universities

• Own our applicant tracking system, and report on hiring progress and time to hire

• Manage recruitment agencies, where they add value

• Coordinate with our Office & Admin Manager on work permits and relocation for international hires

• Source scientists and engineers through academic networks, conferences, and research groups, and run technical screening together with hiring managers

Career growth - HR across the employee life cycle

• Design onboarding that integrates new colleagues quickly

• Own retention initiatives, including employee surveys and follow-up on the results

• Support on building performance reviews and development paths for our employees

• Run offboarding, including exit interviews and knowledge handover

• Be the first point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions

• Keep contracts, policies, and HR documentation compliant with Danish employment law

Building the function

• Prioritize which HR processes, policies, and tools to build first as the company scales

• Manage our collaboration with external HR partners

• Advise management on workforce planning, organization ,and compensation, together with the VP of Finance

Who we are looking for

You are an HR professional with a strong recruitment profile, and you want to grow into or take on a broader HR role. If you don't already have experience within quantum or deep tech, then you should have a keen eye and an ability to learn quickly, so you can help find the best candidates for our team. And you should be excited by the prospect of being part of a company that's on a growth journey, where each day is often different from the next.

Must-haves

• 2 to 6 years of experience in HR, with a clear focus on recruitment

• A clear wish to broaden into HR, from onboarding and development to offboarding

• Working knowledge of Danish employment law and practice

• A structured way of working and sound judgement with confidential matters

• Fluent written and spoken English

Nice-to-haves

• Experience within deep tech, research, or tech, and at a start-up or scale-up

• Experience recruiting scientists or engineers, ideally internationally

• Experience working with Teamtailor and its HRIS Aboard

• Experience setting up HR processes or an applicant tracking system from scratch

• Experience with work permits for non-EU hires

• Experience working with external HR or recruitment partners

What we offer

• Working in a highly motivated team of passionate people at the forefront of photonic quantum technology

• Competitive salary + company paid pension

• DSB Business Card

• Private health insurance

• Flexible working hours and ability to work remotely temporarily

• Six weeks of paid vacation and paid family leave

• Lunch subsidized by the company

• Company phone and company credit card

• Opportunities to attend conferences and workshops

• Steep learning curve in a supportive environment within a rapidly expanding industry

Why Sparrow

• Passionate International Team – Join a group of committed professionals where your perspective and initiative have a direct impact

• Cutting-Edge Projects and Collaborators – Work with world-leading researchers and innovators to shape quantum technology's future

• Growth and Learning – Be part of a supportive culture with mentoring, knowledge sharing, and opportunities to evolve your role

• Career Progression – Grow into project leadership, operations, or funding strategy based on your strengths

• Inclusive Culture – We value diversity and prioritize employee well-being and flexibility

How to apply

Submit your CV and a short cover letter in English via our website: https://sparrowquantum.com/position?id=8695575

We review applications as they arrive and may close the position early, so apply soon. The final deadline is December 1, 2026. For questions about the role, contact Andreas Olesen ao@sparrowquantum.com .

We are committed to a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities.

About Sparrow Quantum

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies and is widely recognized as a leader in single-photon sources.

Our first product is an on-chip single-photon source that delivers more than 20 million high-quality single photons per second into an optical fiber, used by customers for applications such as multi-photon quantum simulation and quantum key distribution.

The patented technology builds on more than two decades of research by founder Peter Lodahl and the Hy-Q Center of Excellence at the Niels Bohr Institute in Copenhagen. Learn more at www.sparrowquantum.com.

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for a Global Mobility Manager to join our office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

DevOps Engineer - Keep the Engine Room Running at RiskPoint

On behalf of RiskPoint, we are looking for a curious and methodical DevOps Engineer to join their growing IT-team. If you are building your DevOps skills and would rather see your work running in production than parked in a slide deck, this could be your next career opportunity.

About RiskPoint:

RiskPoint Group is a fast-growing global Managing General Underwriter (MGU), providing specialist insurance solutions across multiple lines of business in close partnership with leading insurance companies. With more than 325 employees in 18 locations, RiskPoint combines deep underwriting expertise with in-house claims handling and strong business support.

As a DevOps Engineer at RiskPoint, you will become part of a cross-functional global IT-organisation within Finance and Operations, spanning development, architecture, data, infrastructure, and business partnering. RiskPoint is targeting a doubling of the business over the next three years, powered by a digital and AI portfolio built in-house: rating engines on one shared core, AI pipelines that read and route transaction documents, and renewal workbenches redesigned from actual underwriter voice notes. All of it depends on builds, deployments, and environments that simply work.

RiskPoint operates in an agile, collaborative environment with strong cross-border cooperation. Several systems are mid-migration at any given moment, and changes ship across Cyber, Directors and Officers (D&O), Transaction Risk, and Property in parallel. If that sounds chaotic, it is the fun kind. With a flat structure and a culture built on trust and responsibility, RiskPoint offers real impact, ownership, and room to grow.

About the Position:

As a DevOps Engineer at RiskPoint, you will help the teams deliver software reliably by supporting delivery pipelines, cloud environments in Microsoft Azure, and day-to-day automation. You will work close to the engine room of the digital and AI portfolio, helping keep the platforms behind rating engines, AI pipelines, and business applications stable, secure, and repeatable.

This is a role for someone who is building their DevOps skills. You will start with well-defined tasks and build confidence through pairing, code reviews, and guided troubleshooting with experienced colleagues. The focus is on contribution and learning rather than architecture or leadership, and there is real room to grow.

The position is based onsite at RiskPoint's Copenhagen office, and you will collaborate closely with developers, architects, operations and security colleagues, as well as external vendors.

Your key responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

• 
Support CI/CD pipelines by maintaining build, test, and deployment steps, investigating failures, and validating changes before release

• 
Assist with cloud and infrastructure configuration in Microsoft Azure, including routine maintenance and environment checks

• 
Make small, reviewed Infrastructure as Code changes, for example in Terraform, and write or adapt scripts that automate repeatable tasks

• 
Support Kubernetes-based deployments and Helm-based configuration to keep runtime environments stable and consistent

• 
Monitor dashboards, alerts, and logs, troubleshoot methodically, record findings, and escalate when needed

• 
Follow good security and access practice, including least privilege, safe secret handling, and prompt reporting of potential risks

• 
Maintain clear setup guides and runbooks

• 
Use AI tools to understand unfamiliar scripts, draft documentation, and speed up troubleshooting, always with review before production

Please note that applicants must currently reside in Denmark and hold a valid work and residence permit. Fluency in both written and spoken Danish and English is required.

Your Profile - A Great Match for RiskPoint:

For this position, we are looking for a structured, analytical, and pragmatic DevOps Engineer who enjoys working a problem through until it is solved, and documenting it so that nobody has to solve it twice.

You have a relevant education within Computer Science, Information Technology, or a similar discipline, though equivalent practical experience counts just as much as the diploma.

The role carries an underlying expectation: you use AI to build your own methodology, not just RiskPoint's products, and reach for it by default.

To succeed in this role, you should bring:

• 
Foundational knowledge of Git, including commits, branches, and pull requests

• 
An understanding of basic cloud concepts, operating systems, and networking

• 
The ability to read and adapt simple scripts in PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar

• 
A methodical approach to troubleshooting, with the patience to work a problem through and record what you find

• 
Clear communication and a willingness to ask questions, learn from feedback, and document solutions

• 
An interest in agile delivery environments using Jira and GitHub as core engineering tools

You are humble and comfortable collaborating with both technical and non-technical colleagues, and you see feedback as fuel rather than criticism.

Although not required, RiskPoint would prefer candidates who have:

• 
Some exposure to Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions

• 
Some exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Bicep

• 
Some exposure to containers such as Docker, and to Kubernetes or Helm

• 
Personal projects or coursework where you have built, deployed, or automated something end to end

Ready for the next step?

If you see yourself in this role, feel free to reach out to us for a confidential conversation. Please use the form below.

On behalf of RiskPoint, we are looking for a proactive and technically minded Technical Application Support Specialist to join their growing IT-team. If you are early in your developer career and prefer fixing a problem for good over fixing it again next Tuesday, this could be your next career opportunity.

About RiskPoint:

RiskPoint Group is a fast-growing global Managing General Underwriter (MGU), providing specialist insurance solutions across multiple lines of business in close partnership with leading insurance companies. With more than 325 employees in 18 locations, RiskPoint combines deep underwriting expertise with in-house claims handling and strong business support.

As a Technical Application Support Specialist at RiskPoint, you will join the growing Application team within Group IT, part of the wider Finance and Operations department. The team currently consists of nine people, six based at the head office in Copenhagen and three working remotely. With daily stand-ups, the team collaborates closely and helps one another.

RiskPoint operates in an agile, collaborative environment with strong cross-border cooperation. Several systems are mid-migration at any given moment, and changes ship across Cyber, Directors and Officers (D&O), Transaction Risk, and Property in parallel. If that sounds chaotic, it is the fun kind. With a flat structure and a culture built on trust and responsibility, RiskPoint offers real impact, ownership, and room to grow.

You will maintain the stability and functionality of the internal applications and the integrations between them, and you will not just resolve incidents, but identify patterns in recurring issues and recommend improvements before they affect colleagues and daily operations.

• 
Provide technical support for internal applications and integrations, ensuring system stability and minimising operational disruptions

• 
Troubleshoot, analyse root causes, and proactively address recurring issues by looking into logs, data, and integration flows

• 
Query and analyse data with SQL to investigate issues and verify fixes

• 
Investigate and support integrations based on REST and SOAP services and JSON payloads

• 
Make small fixes, scripts, and improvements in JavaScript or .NET, with review from experienced colleagues

• 
Collaborate with analysts, developers, external vendors, and internal stakeholders to implement long-term solutions

• 
Reduce future support requests by improving processes, documentation, and guidance for colleagues

• 
Create and maintain internal documentation and training materials

• 
Manage and prioritise tickets in Jira, ensuring accountability and timely resolution

Your Profile - A Great Match for RiskPoint:

You have a relevant education, such as an AP Degree in Computer Science (datamatiker) or a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, and 1-3 years of experience as a developer, in application support, or in a similar technical role.

The role carries an underlying expectation: you use AI to build your own methodology, not just RiskPoint's products, and reach for it by default.

To succeed in this role, you should bring:

Hands-on experience with SQL, including querying and analysing data

• 
Working knowledge of JSON and of integrations based on REST and SOAP

• 
Development experience in JavaScript and/or .NET

• 
Experience managing tickets and working in agile delivery using Jira or similar tools

• 
A structured approach to troubleshooting and root cause analysis

• 
A service-oriented mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to build relationships

Does it excite you to work with drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics across peptides, proteins and small molecules, and do you have experience with in vitro ADME assays and liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS)

bioanalysis? If this sounds like you, and you are ready to take on a broad area of responsibilities, then you could be our new colleague.

**Your new position

**As Senior Scientist DMPK, you will drive DMPK science from early discovery through development, across a range of modalities. You will support the DMPK discovery platforms and oversee studies run both in-house and with external partners. Your work will turn data into clear insights that guide project decisions and support governance milestones. The role stands out through its focus on peptide drugs for obesity and metabolic health, its mix of in-house and external study work, and the chance to shape digital and automation-enabled approaches within DMPK workflows.

**We Offer Exciting Responsibilities

**

• Drive DMPK/ADME science in drug discovery and development across modalities such as small molecules, peptides and protein therapeutics

• Support DMPK discovery platforms spanning LC-MS bioanalysis, pharmacokinetics, metabolic stability, biotransformation, drug-drug interactions, permeability and transporter studies

• Oversee internal and external DMPK studies from study design through assay development, data interpretation and reporting, ensuring scientific quality, adherence to timelines and complete documentation

• Deliver integrated ADME summaries and high-quality data packages that support project teams, governance milestones and external-facing documentation

• Contribute to continuous improvement by adopting efficient, digital and automation-enabled approaches within DMPK workflows

**Your profile

**You are a collaborative and curious scientist who combines scientific depth with a keen eye for quality and detail. You communicate clearly with colleagues across disciplines and with external partners, and you take ownership of results from study design to final report. You enjoy translating complex data into practical guidance for project teams.

Deep expertise in every area below is not required. You bring:

• A PhD in pharmaceutical sciences, biochemistry, chemistry or a related scientific field, or a Master’s degree combined with more extensive experience

• Several years of relevant post-degree experience in DMPK/ADME

• A track record in pharmacokinetic study design and data interpretationand in feeding DMPK results back to project teams to guide structural optimization and improve the DMPK properties of small molecules and other modalities such as peptides, antibodies and conjugates

• Experience with in vitro ADME assays such as metabolic stability, metabolite identification, drug-drug interactions, absorption/permeability and transporters

• A solid background in bioanalysis and assay development using LC-MS

• Experience working in cross-functional teams and with external contract research organization (CRO) partners, including scientific oversight with an eye for high-quality execution

• Experience with regulatory-relevant DMPK documentation (e.g., support for Investigational New Drug (IND) and Clinical Trial Application (CTA) submissions), and with digital and automation-enabled DMPK workflows is an advantage

**Your new team

**You will join the Global DMPK department within Pharmacokinetics, Immunogenicity and Bioanalytical Sciences, working closely with cross-functional R&D stakeholders (e.g., Discovery, Translational, Toxicology, Clinical Pharmacology, and Regulatory) to shape study strategies, interpret data, and communicate DMPK risks and recommendations.

**Let’s bond and be bold

**We have a unique culture, characterized by excellent teamwork and strong engagement across the organization. And we want you to help us strengthen this culture. Making bonds is at the core of everything we do. From discovering and developing the best new peptide drugs for patients, to engaging with our partners or connecting with each other. We bond through curiosity and playfulness as a team, allowing ourselves to challenge common thinking and drive future innovation. Join us and let’s bond and be bold.

Interested in bonding with us? Then please apply no later than December 19, 2026, or as soon as possible. The applications will be reviewed as they come in. While a cover letter is not required, please include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying_.

We’re looking for a talented optical or nanotech engineer to join our Grating team, where we design and manufacture world-class transmission grating utilizing the advanced processes of the semiconductor industry.

Join to:

• Grow with us: We offer a dynamic, innovation-driven culture with flat hierarchies, agile decision-making, and opportunities to lead innovative projects.

• Balance your work-life: We have flexible conditions and a supportive, multicultural team that values both technical excellence and personal well-being.

• A proactive and determined attitude – you take initiative and drive projects forward.

• Strong communication skills – fluency in English is required, as well as willingness to learn Danish.

Ideally you also have

• An understanding of volume production.

• Experience with statistical modelling.

• Some project management experience.

What we offer

• A workplace where your ideas matter – and where you will see them come to life

• A culture where everyone contributes to a shared goal – and takes pride in the result

• A friendly, respectful work environment with regular social events

• Flexible working hours

Ready to make a difference?

If you believe you are the right candidate for the position, please click ‘Apply for this position’ below to send your CV and cover letter. We are looking to recruit as soon as possible but will keep the positions open until we have found the right candidates. If you want more information about the positions, please call Lars Bo Madsen on +45 6079 0130 or email lbm@ibsen.com.

We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

About Ibsen Photonics

Ibsen’s core technology is optical transmission gratings and grating based spectrometers, which we design, manufacture and supply to customers worldwide. Our spectrometers find their way into medical devices and scientific instruments used in sustainable energy, industrial, pharmaceutical, life sciences, security, and many other applications.

We work closely with our customers to create value adding solutions, sharing our extensive technical knowledge in an open and honest work environment with a flat “Scandinavian” hierarchical structure.

jobs.occupation: Advanced Laboratory Technician - In vivo Research
jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**You will support in building the experimental foundation of a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research, established to generate and validate innovative therapeutic concepts in cardiometabolic disease and healthspan. As one of two Advanced Laboratory Technicians in In vivo Research, you will turn scientific questions into well-executed rodent studies and shape the team’s capabilities from the start. Your work helps bring new projects into the early discovery pipeline.

**What You Will Bring

**You are a trained laboratory technician, hold a relevant technical qualification, or bring equivalent practical experience.

• Strong hands-on experience in rodent research, including mouse and rat handling, dosing and sampling.

• Relevant training and authorisation for the animal procedures you will undertake, as applicable.

• A careful, organised approach to experimental work, documentation and data quality.

• The ability to work independently within agreed study plans and to coordinate with colleagues.

• Curiosity, practical problem-solving skills and an interest in learning new methods.

• Confidence in sharing observations, suggesting improvements and asking questions.

• The ability to communicate and document your work in English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Metabolic phenotyping, including food intake, body composition, glucose regulation or indirect calorimetry.

• Behavioural testing and neuroscience-related experimental methods.

• Rodent surgery and postoperative care.

• Tissue dissection, sample processing and ex vivo methods.

• In vitro assays supporting pharmacological or mechanistic studies.

• Establishing new laboratory methods or workflows.

You are not expected to bring experience in every technique. We welcome complementary profiles.

**What You Will Do

**Working closely with scientists and fellow laboratory technicians, you will contribute to studies that test new ideas and help set up how the team works in the lab. More specifically, you will:

• Plan, coordinate and perform mouse and rat pharmacology experiments, including dosing, observations, sampling and relevant physiological measurements.

• Perform metabolic phenotyping and contribute to behavioural studies, according to your expertise and training.

• Collect and process biological samples for ex vivo and laboratory analyses.

• Contribute to developing, optimising and troubleshooting experimental methods.

• Record, quality-check and organise experimental data, and flag observations that may affect interpretation or later studies.

• Bring practical expertise to study planning and to discussions of results.

• Help establish laboratory workflows, maintain equipment and coordinate materials and study activities, working to relevant procedures, animal welfare requirements and the principles of replacement, reduction and refinement.

Depending on your experience, you may also contribute to rodent surgery, specialised neuroscience methods or in vitro assays. Training will support the introduction of additional techniques.

**Who You Will Work With

**You will join a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research, part of Research & Development, working alongside scientists and laboratory colleagues with expertise in physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience and molecular innovation. Scientific and technical colleagues plan experiments together, deliver them together and interpret the observations together, so your view counts at every step. The team is headed by Christoffer Clemmensen.

You will also work with animal facility staff and laboratory specialists across the organisation.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will help shape the experimental practices of a new team. Your technical judgement, observations and suggestions will be valued as part of the research process, and you will be trusted to work independently within agreed study plans.

**Your impact begins today. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as you can.

You will also contribute to technical documentation, including development reports, technology transfer documentation, and relevant regulatory submissions.

**We are looking for an experienced scientist with strong technical knowledge of mammalian upstream processes and the ability to translate scientific data into practical recommendations.

**We Imagine That You

• Have at least five years of relevant industry experience with a Master's degree or two years with a PhD, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Have solid experience with mammalian cell culture processes, including bioreactor operations and scale-up.

• Have experience with late-stage process development, such as process characterization, scale-down models, or technology transfer.

• Can design studies, apply statistical methods, interpret complex data, and communicate scientifically sound conclusions.

• Have experience with process risk assessments and preparing clear scientific reports and technical documentation.

When challenges arise, you approach them calmly and logically, communicate openly about progress and risks, and involve colleagues or your manager when support is need.

You are comfortable discussing scientific findings with clients, explaining the rationale behind your recommendations, and working with others to resolve challenges. You value mutual respect, open communication, and learning from colleagues.

**What We Offer

**At AGC Biologics, you will work on different client projects, helping prepare mammalian upstream processes for clinical and commercial manufacturing.

**We Offer

**

• The opportunity to lead late-stage upstream development studies and work on different scientific and process challenges.

• A multidisciplinary environment where scientific discussions, collaboration, and knowledge sharing are part of everyday work.

• A manager who gives you room to plan your work independently, values honest discussions, and is available when you need support.

• An initial mentoring arrangement to help you become familiar with our processes, systems, and ways of working.

Please submit your application and CV through our recruitment system. Applications will be reviewed continuously, and we reserve the right to close the job posting once we have found the right candidate.

From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. SOUNDBOKS is an innovative tech company and aspiring lifestyle brand. You may have seen us at a music festival, street party, or your friend’s celebration (think: private events combining festival-grade sound with beat-enhancing lights) where special moments are turned into memories. We create the loudest, most durable, and arguably coolest Bluetooth speakers and audio reactive lights on the market.

At SOUNDBOKS, trust and community go hand in hand. People are encouraged to take ownership of their work while knowing they have the support of the team behind them. Voices are heard, ideas are welcomed, and collaboration is what pushes us forward.

This is more than a job - it’s a community where people care about each other, celebrate together, and share the energy of creating something meaningful. Life at SOUNDBOKS is bold, fast, and full of passion - for the product, for the mission, and for showing up as your true self. With 70 team members, this is a place where you can do your best work and truly belong.

ROLE ACOUSTIC ENGINEER

TEAM PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

HOURS FULL TIME

LOCATION COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

START DATE OCTOBER 2026 or ASAP

The Product Development team at SOUNDBOKS is the group responsible for the exciting product journey, taking every step of the development process toward and into mass production. In it’s heartbeat you’ll find collaborative and self-driven team members with a large cross-discipline understanding tied to ownership. They are there to make a difference - for the products, the team and the SOUNDBOKS customers as a whole.

Every SOUNDBOKS starts with a great idea - but turning it into a speaker that can survive a festival, run for hours, and sound incredible takes a lot of engineering. As the Acoustic Engineer, you'll be taking charge of the acoustic development that helps bring those products to life.

Okay, let’s make things a little more concrete. Here’s what we expect your daily life to look like:

**Concept & Prototype Development

**

• You'll select and design acoustic components based on product and market requirements.

• You'll define initial enclosure concepts.

• You'll build and evaluate proof-of-concept prototypes to validate acoustic concepts.

• You'll collaborate with Mechanical Engineering during the early product development phase to mature acoustic concepts.

**Simulation & Validation

**

• You'll perform acoustic simulations with a focus on sound pressure level (SPL), sound quality, and system efficiency.

• You'll validate simulation results through physical testing.

• You'll collaborate with suppliers to refine acoustic components based on simulation and test results.

**Driver Specification & Verification

**

• You'll own the technical specification of loudspeaker drivers towards suppliers.

• You'll define driver specifications and tolerances.

• You'll support manufacturing verification with suppliers.

• You'll participate in the acoustic verification of the final product towards mass production.

• You'll collaborate with the Audio team on audio signal handling, including crossovers, compressors, and limiters.

**In order to become a success in this role, we believe that your profile should be aligned with the bullets listed below. However, we acknowledge that success can take many forms, so please do apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

**

• You have proven experience designing and simulating loudspeakers, including transducer design and specification, enclosure design, and acoustic measurements.

• You hold a BSc or higher in Audio, Acoustics, Mechanical, or a related engineering discipline.

• You've done loudspeaker simulation and measurements, and use both to validate and refine your designs.

• You've worked with loudspeaker development from concept through verification and ideally have experience collaborating with external manufacturing partners.

• Familiarity with crossover design, FEM simulations, or failure analysis is an advantage.

• Ideally you also have experience building physical speaker mock-ups or collaborating with large-scale loudspeaker manufacturing partners.

• You work independently, take ownership of your area, and enjoy collaborating closely with engineers across disciplines.

• You're curious, creative, and constantly looking for ways to improve acoustic performance.

• You're drawn to what SOUNDBOKS is building and are excited to be a part of the journey!

Intrigued? At SOUNDBOKS you’ll find yourself a part of a community. We realize that growth is a process and we don’t expect you to go through it alone. Actually, we guarantee that you won’t have to. We work together in order to work smarter, we inspire each other to be better, and we never forget that every member of the team is responsible for our success.

So, if you’re tired of all of the noise in the job market, we’d love to hear from you. This may be the coolest job you ever have!

jobs.occupation: Design for Value & Cost Engineer – from concept to competitive edge, GN Hearing, Ballerup
jobs.description:
Are you ready to apply your engineering, project leadership and sourcing expertise to the world of product development and manufacturing? Join us as Senior Project Manager in Design for Value (DfV) and impact the way we design, develop, and manufacture products at GN Hearing in Ballerup.

The team you will be part of:

Based at our global HQ, located in Ballerup, Denmark, you will join the Design for Value team in Global Manufacturing & Operations, reporting directly to Director René Bergqvist.

In this role, you will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders worldwide, ensuring value and cost are managed effectively and optimized in our products from the early concept phase through to mass production.

Your contribution is appreciated and you will:

• Optimize products by supporting the organization with cost / value analysis in our products, modules, platforms and architecture

• Investigate and motivate for cost-effective design and manufacturability, e.g. via mapping of value / cost opportunities related to roadmap, product, and design options

• Manage cost targets and running estimate for ramp up in development projects

• Facilitate and support project sourcing activities including availability reviews, supplier selection, RFQs, and negotiations

• Support building positive business cases together with R&D & Product Marketing

• Facilitate and conduct project reviews related to Design for Value, Cost and Manufacturing

• Follow up and guard the cost in product development by working with R&D on their suggested specification, manufacturing or material selection

You will also work on introducing new technologies and innovations during product development and play a key role in approving targets and results before critical milestones are passed.

You will also support key cross-functional projects that are part of strategic initiatives (“must-win battles”) with significant value or savings impact from an Operations and Sourcing perspective.

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you - besides having a technical mindset and a good business understanding - have:

• A degree or similar within engineering, preferably within electronics

• Experience within platform and product development, supplier sourcing or cost/value optimization in a R&D environment are positive differentiators

• Good at solving both technical and commercial issues

• General understanding of manufacturing processes and industrialization

• Experience with LEAN, Design for Value/Cost, or supplier sourcing in Asia, are positive differentiators

• Presentation, negotiation, and communication skills in English, both written and spoken

In addition, you have an engaging personality and possess facilitation skills, enabling you to build networks and engage stakeholders. You also possess solid analytical and problem-solving abilities, which you use to identify issues and propose effective solutions.

You are, furthermore, steadfast and enjoy working in a multicultural, changing environment. You take initiative and, most importantly, follow through on the initiatives you start.

We offer:

• A unique opportunity to grow and gain experience across both engineering and business

• A supportive and dynamic work environment where you can learn to navigate change with confidence

• Opportunities for professional and personal growth in a top-tier global high-tech company.

• The chance to contribute meaningfully to GN

• An international and collaborative workplace

We encourage you to apply

We highly value a mindset, motivation, and energy, that align with our core values, to not only ensure your growth, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the Interview please let the hiring manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.

How to apply?

Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 25 November 2026. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

Join us in bringing people closer

GN brings people closer through our leading intelligent hearing, inspired by people and driven by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We help people with hearing loss overcome real-life challenges, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.

GN has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.
